card.name: Abundance
card.oracle_text: If you would draw a card, you may instead choose land or nonland and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library in any order.

effects.condition: REPLACES a draw, does not happen on its own; land-or-nonland is chosen at that time
